messages:
Zane: FYI — AcmeHealth sent a security/compliance packet and a retention ask. Link: https://drive.google.com/some-doc. They want 10-year audit logs + BAA. Sale asks: can we support this for Hosted/Dedicated/Private?
Maria: grabbing thread. Quick summary from the packet: exportable logs to customer bucket, KMS encryption, immutability window, per-request redaction.
Emma: timeline? do they need this before launch or as an optional feature?
Zane: RFP says launch target in ~6 months, HIPAA in-scope before go-live. Sales needs an eng feasibility + high-level estimate by EOW.
Raj: 10y retention is large. Our hosted defaults up to 3y. Private/dedicated can be longer but requires storage+indexing work. Questions: must logs be immutable? KMS/HSM requirements?
Maria: they explicitly want logs exported to their GCP bucket, encrypted with their KMS, and an immutability/legal-hold option. Also want a redacted view for PII on exports.
Leo: from eng perspective — rough work: storage pipeline + export connector + KMS hook + immutability flags + redaction tooling = ~6–8 wks core infra if we dedicate resources. Huge variance based on tokens/day. Need volumes.
Nora: legal: we will need a signed BAA and data processing addendum. Long retention raises cross-border & GDPR issues — need to confirm jurisdictions and lawful basis. Also ask: who can request access?
Emma: suggest we triage into an "enterprise compliance" epic. Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) export to customer bucket with SSE-C or customer-managed KMS, 2) configurable immutable retention up to 10y, 3) role-based audit access & export audit trail, 4) per-route or per-request PII redaction option. Decision + estimate by next Tue.
Raj: add automated purge + legal-hold override + periodic key rotation to acceptance criteria. Also confirm whether exported logs must be sealed (not modifiable).
Maria: I'll request sample export schema and expected tokens/day from the customer. Also to clarify: do they need a continuous export (stream) or ad-hoc bundles?
Zane: They're leaning Private but evaluating Dedicated. Sales will push for Private if we can confirm feasibility.
OpsBot: Ticket created: PROD-4321. Assignees: Emma, Raj, Leo, Maria.
Emma: scheduling scoping meeting Fri 11:00am — @Leo @Raj please prepare rough tech approach and security checklist.
Leo: will prepare cost calc (storage + egress) and pipeline sketch.
Raj: I'll draft HIPAA+SOC2 checklist and call out GDPR retention conflicts.
Maria: quick Q — can we produce an "evidence bundle" for external auditors as part of the deliverable?
Nora: yes, in principle. Evidence bundle content depends on where logs are stored and access controls. We'll need signed attestations and properly-timestamped audit trails. I'll outline required artifacts.
Zane: customer happy with proposed planning window. I'll push for token volume and sample export by EOD tomorrow.
Emma: thank you — keep updates in this thread. Closing loop when we have the sample + token counts. :party_parrot:
